3. REFILL WITH ENGINE OIL
(a) To wipe off oil that has dripped onto the engine under cover, remove the 4 screws and bend the under cover downward.
NOTICE:
• To avoid damaging the silencer, do not bend the engine under cover more than 150 mm (5.91 in.).
• If oil gets on the silencer, wipe it off with a dry rag.
(b) Clean and install the oil drain plug with a new gasket.
Torque: 38 N·m (375 kgf·cm, 27 ft·lbf)
(c) Fill with fresh engine oil.
